text:
Hannah (CSM): Kickoff for MapleWave QBR prep. Meeting next Wed 10am PT. Need: short account health, onboarding friction notes, token econ (30/90d), and a tight cost-action slide with concrete asks. Who owns cost + forecast?

Tariq (FinOps): I can take cost. Will produce 90d baseline, 30d spike table, and a 10-week forecast (base/conservative/aggressive). Any heavy nightly jobs we should exclude from trend?

Zoe (Solutions): They run a bulk reindex at 02:30 UTC daily; that caused two quota hits last month. I have the job manifest and a quick fix (shard staggering + local cache) to demo.

Luis (Sales): Renewal convo in 3 weeks. CFO wants mitigation plan + reserved commit quote. Also asked if we can show per-key/per-route cost in the Console.

Hannah (CSM): Perfect. Owners: Tariq = cost + forecast; Zoe = tech split + demo; Luis = renewal asks + exec bullets. I'll compile onboarding feedback (starter kit) and capture their top 3 asks.

ops-bot: export: maplewave_tokens_3301234567.csv uploaded to s3://exports/maplewave/3301234567.csv

Tariq (FinOps): Uploaded forecast + anonymized spike chart: https://files.redwood/maplewave/3301234567/forecast.png. Key: two overnight reindex windows account for ~33% of peak-week tokens. Recommend: 1) embed cache TTL=7d 2) int8 quant for batch model 3) 80% daily alert with auto-throttle.

Zoe (Solutions): Demo plan: run reindex in staging before/after caching+stagger. Snippet for stagger I'll show:

```
# stagger example
for shard in 0 1 2 3; do
  sleep $((shard * 20))
  ./reindex --shard=$shard &
done
```

I'll collect tokens/sec and cost/time.

Luis (Sales): I'll draft ask slide: 1) reserved capacity options (3 tiers) 2) temporary credit bridge 3) set daily cap + 80% alerting. CFO also requested p99 latency hosted vs dedicated.

Hannah (CSM): Two quick product asks for the deck: can we show per-route cost in Console and a screenshot of the new per-key breakdown?

Zoe (Solutions): Yes, Console supports both. I'll grab a blurred screenshot and add an annotation showing route-level tokens.

Tariq (FinOps): I'll add a hosted vs dedicated delta table and estimated savings for each commit level. Also including a short note: on Private deployments we may need a local cache connector which adds setup time.

Hannah (CSM): Action deadlines: Tariq cost + CSV by Tue 2pm; Zoe demo + screenshots by Wed 9am; Luis asks by Tue EOD. Dry run Wed 9:30. Anyone blocked?

Luis (Sales): CFO asked whether we can set automated spend escalation at 90% daily that pauses non-critical pipelines. If feasible, include it as a near-term win.

Tariq (FinOps): We support tiered alerts and auto-throttle rules. I'll include sample JSON for the alert rule and recommended thresholds.

Zoe (Solutions): One tradeoff: if they switch to Dedicated with a strict VPC, some managed caching layers may need extra infra. I'll call that out and propose a hybrid approach (local Redis + replicate).

Hannah (CSM): I'll gather onboarding tickets: top flags = "unclear batching defaults", "no starter configs", "quota surprises". We'll propose a MapleWave Starter Kit: batching defaults, cache snippet, alert rules.

ops-bot: ticket MW-9021 updated: starter-kit checklist added

Hannah (CSM): Thanks team  I'll ping Tue morning for status and prep the deck template. :pray:
